intro: Now you write it. The sentence starter is the same one in your casefile — use it. Getting used to it now is how it becomes automatic in June, when every point on the Regents essay counts.
prompt: You have the evidence from Document 6. Now explain it: what does it show, and why does that matter?
checklist: Says what the evidence shows, in your own words
Says why it matters (“which matters because”)
Ties back to the question you are answering
model_response: This shows Adam Smith argued that government should leave business alone, which matters because his argument told British owners that putting money into mills and machines, and keeping the profits, would make the whole nation richer.

documents.source_document: Document 6 — An introduction to The Wealth of Nations
documents.source_citation: Source: Introduction to a re-publication of Adam Smith's The Wealth of Nations, likely written by Martin Perry in 2013
documents.source_text: The Wealth of Nations carries the important message of laissez faire, which means that the government should intervene as little as possible in economic affairs and leave the market to its own devices. It advocates the liberation of economic production from all limiting regulation in order to benefit the people . . .
